responsibilities: Act as a senior hands-on engineer, designing, building, testing, deploying and supporting data engineering solutions.
Lead and line-manage a small team of 3–4 data engineers, analysts and QAs providing technical direction, coaching, feedback and development.
Lead delivery of ASB data engineering initiatives while also contributing directly to the codebase and technical implementation.
Design, build and optimise production-grade data pipelines, transformations and integration solutions.
Write high-quality, maintainable SQL and dbt code and contribute directly to complex engineering work where required.
Review code produced by the team, provide constructive technical feedback and ensure agreed engineering standards are consistently applied.
Lead technical and solution design reviews and make pragmatic engineering decisions where requirements, designs or delivery approaches are unclear.
Establish and maintain engineering standards covering coding, testing, documentation, source control, deployment, monitoring and support.
Translate business, data and financial crime requirements into practical end-to-end technical solutions.
Work across Snowflake, dbt, IBM StreamSets and related technologies to support cloud, on-premises and Oracle-integrated data patterns.
Diagnose and resolve complex data, performance and integration issues, including production problems where required.
Build data quality, reconciliation, load assurance and control requirements into engineering solutions.
Identify technical risks, dependencies and delivery constraints early and drive them through to resolution.
Work closely with engineers, architects, database teams, business SMEs and technology stakeholders to support successful delivery.
Promote reusable engineering patterns, automation and continuous improvement that improve delivery speed, maintainability and control.
Ensure solutions are secure, resilient, scalable and aligned with relevant enterprise technology and engineering standards.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Establish and maintain engineering standards covering coding, testing, documentation, source control, deployment, monitoring and support
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities repeatedly emphasize engineering standards, testing, data quality, reconciliation and control mechanisms with no velocity/speed language, clearly rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Financial Crime Compliance (FCC)... driving the Group's approach to managing Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (AML/CTF), Sanctions, Anti-Bribery and Corruption (ABC)
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The team's explicit purpose is regulatory financial-crime compliance (AML/CTF, sanctions, ABC), an unambiguous regulatory override to high domain risk.
evidence.collaboration_width: ASB; FCC Australia and New Zealand; technology teams; architects; database teams; business SMEs
evidence.data_team_maturity: Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) is a team of over 190 professionals and is an integral part of CBA's Group Risk Function
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A 190-person compliance function with established enterprise technology standards and existing production pipelines to optimise indicates a mature, specialised operation.
evidence.jd_authorship: Work across Snowflake, dbt, IBM StreamSets and related technologies to support cloud, on-premises and Oracle-integrated data patterns
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name specific tools, team size, and precise integration patterns, giving a very clear picture of daily work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Financial Crime Compliance... Transaction Monitoring and broader financial crime initiatives
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role sits entirely within a financial crime compliance/audit function reporting to an Executive Manager, a clear finance/compliance orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: You will act as both a senior individual contributor and the technical and people lead for a small team
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines hands-on execution (writing code, building pipelines) with strategic technical leadership (setting direction, establishing standards, leading a team), a genuine mix.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tool usage or AI-infrastructure-building expectation appears anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Establish and maintain engineering standards covering coding, testing, documentation, source control, deployment, monitoring and support
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing and quality/control mechanisms are explicitly framed as standards the candidate establishes and owns as team lead, not just listed skills.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Build data quality, reconciliation, load assurance and control requirements into engineering solutions
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Compliance, control, reconciliation and risk language dominates the JD throughout, reflecting fear of regulatory exposure and bad data affecting financial crime detection.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design, build and optimise production-grade data pipelines, transformations and integration solutions
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role optimises and extends existing production pipelines and engineering standards rather than building a function from scratch.
evidence.loss_aversion: Build data quality, reconciliation, load assurance and control requirements into engineering solutions — reflects dominant regulatory/compliance risk framing given the Financial Crime Compliance context.
